helpDesc: Show all commands and what they do.
recentCommandsHelp: NEW COMMANDS: /ucolour {color} [player] Set a player's color; player defaults to you. /give {role} [players...] | @all Give a role immediately; player defaults to you. /set {role} [players...] | @all Set next-round role only for listed players; omitted player means you. Supports Crewmate, Scientist, Engineer, Guardian Angel, Noisemaker, Tracker, Detective, Judge, Spirit Guide, and impostor roles. Examples: /set scientist PlayerName; /set engineer @all. /add {role} [players...] Add players to a next-round role; omitted player means you. /rolereset {role} Restore random assignment. /playerreset [player] Reset a player's queued role, given role, and color; omitted player means you. /impcount {1-15} Choose next-round impostor-team count. /voteout [player] Vote out a player in a meeting; omitted player means you. /cvoteout {color} Vote out the player with that color in a meeting. /setvotes {player|!color:black|@all|@me} {0-100} Set how many votes a living player gets when they vote in this meeting; host only. /revive [player|@all] Revive yourself, a selected dead player, or every dead player. /tm, /tiemeeting Force the current meeting vote to end in a tie.
